column1: # Czech (cs) catalog. Same format as zh-hant.tsv:  context <TAB> source <TAB> translation
# (empty context = a plain UI string; `@id` = a command id; `@plural` = "one|few|other" forms).
# Clean-room: every entry is written from the meaning of VectorCraft's English label, following
# common Czech desktop-software conventions (commands in the infinitive, menus as nouns); no other
# application's Czech localisation was consulted or copied.
# Panels, dialogs, tooltips, command labels, plurals and status/error messages were added later in
# the same clean-room way, drafted with AI assistance (Claude) from the English meaning; not yet
# reviewed by a native speaker. Vocabulary: pracovní plocha (artboard), cesta (path), kotevní bod
# (anchor point), úchyt (handle), tah (stroke), výplň (fill), přechod (gradient), vzorník and
# položka vzorníku (Swatches panel, a swatch), vzorek (pattern), krytí (opacity), prolnutí (blend),
# režim míchání (blending mode), přednastavení (preset), rozložit (expand), uvolnit (release),
# vektorizace obrazu (Image Trace). Counts without a plural row read "Label: {n}".
# Coverage: every menu string, tl! literal, plural, status and error message (`untranslated_report` lists gaps:
# `complete_menus` and `COMPLETE_MESSAGES`). Left in English on purpose (`MENU_KEEP_AS_IS` in the
# tests): the product name, language names, OpenType, the built-in workspace names and the
# bracketed perspective grid preset names. Keep placeholders, ellipses and the leading/trailing
